interfaces.name: prepared
interfaces.constraints: Plain dict with exactly features, feature_columns, observed_mask and observed_values. Upstream replay owns value validation; this adapter accepts arbitrary borrowed values. Caller owns availability, units, row alignment and downstream mutation.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: New outer tuple in fixed order: features, feature_columns, observed_mask, observed_values. Preserve borrowed identity and shared aliases. No copying, numerical validation, casting, field renaming or model execution. Concrete in-process projection only; abstract witness rejects. Source-schema adapter, not a generic numerical algorithm. No empirical transfer, HTTP transport or whole-CDG approval claim.

providers.operation: Expose features, structured columns, observation mask and values in order. Require a plain mapping with exactly the four frozen-replay fields. Return borrowed values as a tuple without conversion or mutation. This operation only projects ports: upstream replay owns value validation and caller owns units, availability, alignment and downstream mutation of borrowed values.
